cohort: The study included 245 healthy Hungarian children (142 boys, 103 girls) aged 0-36 months.
finding: Faecal calprotectin (FC) levels peaked in children aged 0-4 months and declined steadily thereafter, providing age-specific reference values for healthy Hungarian children under 3 years.
mod_finding: No significant association was found between faecal calprotectin levels and mode of delivery.
